If $A$ and $B$ are mutually exclusive events, then $P(A \cup B)$ is equal to
solutionSteps: $P(A \cup B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A \cap B) = P(A) + P(B)$.

Case Study: Three coins are tossed once. The sample space is $S = \{HHH, HHT, HTH, THH, HTT, THT, TTH, TTT\}$.
(i) Find the probability of getting 3 heads.
(ii) Find the probability of getting exactly 2 heads.
(iii) Find the probability of getting at least 2 heads.
solutionSteps: (iii) At least 2 Heads (2 or 3): $\{HHT, HTH, THH, HHH\}$. Prob = $4/8 = 1/2$.
